description: MiniMax: MiniMax M3 via OpenRouter. MiniMax-M3 is a multimodal foundation model from MiniMax. It supports text, image, and video inputs with text output, a 1M-token context window, and is suited for long-horizon agentic work, coding,
sources: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ibragim-bad/swe_rebench_07_2026_trajectories (resolved flags only; IRT fit in data/outcomes)
notes: AA coding index 58.6, intelligence 29.2, agentic 29.5. Prices are OpenRouter list prices (per-token x 1e6) from /api/v1/models on 2026-10-25; they can differ per upstream provider. Context/max output are the top provider values. Latency is estimated: OpenRouter exposes no latency/throughput stats in the public API. Non-coding skill axes derived from coding theta with fixed offsets (tweaked per model), not measured. Outcome calibration 2026-10-26: coding fitted 7.37 +/- 0.54 on the router scale from rebench07/minimax-m3 (exact model); all axes shifted by +0.7. See data/outcomes/REPORT.md.
